about: cap.so a fifth time: the hero with the laptop mock-up, the feature sections, Pricing in the sticky nav bar, then Lifetime. Recorded 2026-09-25 as 'Cap-demo (3)': production zoomed on Lifetime and missed Pricing; the replay then missed both.
notes: Pricing: the hand is on the link from 10.3s and the pricing page arrives at 10.9s, so the click is ~10.8s. The tracker logged the swap as a one-frame dy of -0.249, and the video's own scroll reading ALSO reported a shift for it (median of its regions) — with only 31% of the regions agreeing. events.js videoScrolled now asks for agreement.

Lifetime: the hand rests on the switch from 14.0s and it flips at ~14.8s. Chrome stopped drawing the idle pointer at 16.6s and it reappeared at 20.1s a little away; dwells() ran one rest from 14.0 to 20.1 placed where it reappeared, and its one press went to 20.5s. A hole the pointer comes out of somewhere else now ends the rest.
stranger_budget_s / stranger_budget_pixel_s are RATCHETS measured on 2026-09-25. Lower them when they improve; never raise them.
